title: Abstention-Honesty Score: Measuring 'I Don't Know' Under Adversarial Unknowns

original_idea.body: Abstention-Honesty Score. Problem: no public benchmark separates genuine epistemic abstention from over-refusal by injecting unanswerable-by-construction and fabricated-entity questions alongside answerable ones, scoring honest abstention vs confabulation. Direction: mix answerable facts, unknowable questions, and plausible-but-fake entities; score an Abstention-Honesty metric rewarding honest abstention and penalizing confabulation; report fake-entity confabulation rate.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain (isolating confabulation -> honesty evals -> safer deployment) with a gap to concrete catastrophic scenario.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single well-defined benchmark with clear metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: External auditing on public models with synthetic data.

novelty.reasoning: Abstention/confabulation well-studied; fabricated-entity isolation may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Abstention benchmarks exist but the fabricated-entity isolation angle is plausibly open.
